## Core Technical Competencies
- FinTech & Payments: UPI App Testing, Peer-to-Peer (P2P) & Peer-to-Merchant (P2M) transfers, Bank SDK timeouts, Double-debit idempotency validation, Merchant settlement audits.
- Identity & Compliance: Aadhaar eKYC integration, Biometric SDK drivers, OTP retry mechanics, PII AES-256 data security.
- API Testing & Automation: Postman collection suites, Newman CLI integration, PyTest framework architecture, Rest API contract validation.
- Database Quality Assurance: MySQL ledger reconciliation, double-entry bookkeeping queries, row-level transaction locking, index performance audits.
- Performance & Mobile QA: Apache JMeter stress testing, latency mocking, Appium mobile automation, Android ADB testing.
